results.title: On Memories of Countless Days Away
results.overview: Two friends recall their childhoods in Singapore, revisit their earlier films and perform a dance for which no recording remains. Their musings and archives are woven together in a meditation on how memories are not recovered, but composed anew.

results.title: Senrab
results.overview: London, 2026. As independent music venues rapidly shut their doors, new bands like Senrab are forced to take their voices underground.

results.title: SAKANA
results.overview: Kana accidentally falls asleep while taking a bath and is transported to the ruins of another world ruled by mutant fish. Holding a katana, she battles fish-headed people and a giant eel. When she wakes up and thinks it was only a hallucination, a character…

results.title: Carla Lonzi, A Feminist Story
results.original_title: Carla Lonzi - Dentro e fuori dal mondo
results.overview: Alongside the public figure Carla Lonzi, considered to be so uncompromising, there is much to say about her private side, as fascinating as it was contradictory. There’s her tenderness and emotional fragility, her dependence on her partner, hence on a man; her complicated feelings about motherhood; and strained relationships with other women in the practice of collective harikiri called “consciousness-raising”. Drawing on invaluable, unreleased archive material, the filmmaker Francesca Archibugi, who was very close to Lonzi, brings her public life and private story, her ideas, and her legacy to the screen for the first time. These are key to understanding what women around the world are still going through and fighting for.

results.title: Get Lost
results.overview: Lost deep in the woods, a hiker's journey takes an unsettling turn when he encounters a stranger.

results.title: Tha path we cannot see
results.overview: After a family prayer, Sara and Elie return home with an object they stole from their aunt. This decision leads them to experience a night in which a power outage triggers an inevitable encounter. A book, a song, and a house shrouded in darkness.

results.title: Bliss
results.overview: A worker trapped in the monotony of his office job discovers an emotional escape hidden behind his desktop windows

results.title: The Heart of a Dominatrix
results.overview: Dominatrix Innana Justice, based in Paris, offers a behind-the-scenes look at BDSM—and, of course, at the role of a dominatrix. Spanning several chapters and featuring an ensemble of international sex workers and performers, this dynamic portrait explores a wide range of topics and practices related to BDSM, work, and community—from sessions to activism.

results.title: Problem at the Address
results.overview: Sabri (72) dreams of taking a photo with a politician. With his nephew Ahmet’s (38) help, it happens but the photo never arrives. When the meeting video goes viral, Ahmet’s quiet life unravels under political rumors.

results.title: A Woman Asleep
results.overview: Inspired by A Man Asleep by Georges Perec, A Woman Asleep explores contemporary alienation in a world of constant connection and endless information. Following a shifting group of women, the film uses synthetic imagery and the director’s own voice clone to reflect a society that keeps looking, yet no longer truly sees or feels. Based on an semi-autobiographical original script, A Woman Asleep takes an essayistic form, echoing Resnais, Marker, Antonioni, and Akerman as fiction, memory, and reflection blur.

results.title: The End Date
results.overview: Eat cauliflower with mayonnaise. Sort through papers. Take care of the chickens. Feed the metastases. Learn poems. Drink beer. Prepare his family.  Although doctors gave him three years to live, Yann Patou lived with cancer for 18 years. As death approaches, Yann tries to keep smiling and constantly reminds me that we must ‘hurry up and live.

results.title: Everlasting Quijote
results.overview: This documentary chronicles the creative process behind the ambitious artistic project «Viva Don Quijote», conceived and developed by the German-Russian artist Genia Chef.  Originally inspired by a tribute to the illustrator Teodoro Miciano, the film offers an intimate look into Genia Chef's studio as he reinterprets Miguel de Cervantes’ universal literary masterpiece through a contemporary artistic lens. Rather than following a conventional biographical structure, the documentary explores the convergence of classic Spanish literature and modern plastic arts, capturing the philosophical depth, aesthetic challenges, and ongoing relevance of the iconic knight in today's visual culture.

results.title: Deathguard: Career Counselor
results.overview: No victims. No purpose. Just rejection emails.

results.title: Sun Day
results.overview: The Sun is walking around at work when loads of horrible stuff happens and it freaks the Sun out a little bit too much

results.title: Insomnia
results.overview: All six members of RIIZE act out separate, overlapping vignettes of personal sleeplessness, capturing how each individual processes quiet isolation, tangled thoughts, and the longing for a person or release before the morning comes.

results.title: Superman Fell to the Steppe
results.overview: Kazım, struggling to make ends meet, accepts a job performing as Superman in a circus. But refusing to shave the mustache he has worn for thirty years forces him to choose between his identity and his livelihood. After a series of unfortunate events in his village, the locals mistake him for a mysterious hero. A tragicomic story of a powerless man trapped inside a costume that symbolizes strength, exploring poverty, dignity, and society’s longing to create heroes.

results.title: Dumpster
results.overview: Sultan is an elderly woman living alone in Istanbul. While waiting for her son and grandson on Mother’s Day, she becomes increasingly angered by a pile of garbage across the street. She begins warning people from her window not to throw their rubbish onto the street and gradually becomes an authority figure whose word is obeyed throughout the neighborhood. Empowered by the fear she inspires in others, Sultan begins to see herself as the protector of the neighborhood. When a garbage container is placed in the neighborhood and disrupts the order she has established, Sultan secretly removes it, determined to regain control over her surroundings.

results.title: Dreaming of a Dream
results.overview: Set in 1990s Berlin, “Dreaming of a Dream” follows Kerem, a sensitive 12-year-old Turkish boy on the edge of adolescence. When Kerem steals an adult magazine from a local store with his friends, this little adventure soon begins to strain his relationship with them and with his mother. For the first time, Kerem finds himself wrestling with desire and shame, and with the unspoken codes of masculinity.
